params.note: all pages merged, newest first. acus_consumed is per session; for billed totals use GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/consumption/daily/users/{user_id}
`raw` is the original API item. Knowledge notes have created_by_user_id=null because the notes API has no creator; take it from enrichment/knowledge_note_owners.json

enrichment/org_directory.json.source: HR system / IdP export (user_id, name, email also in GET /v3beta1/organizations/{org_id}/members/users)

enrichment/knowledge_note_owners.json.source: Not in Devin API: note creator registry

enrichment/knowledge_note_usage.json.source: Not in Devin API: Session Insights > Knowledge Usage, or own tracking

enrichment/automation_triggers.json.source: Not in Devin API: actor from the trigger event (GitHub/Slack/Linear)

enrichment/document_reviews.json.source: Not in Devin API: document store review status
